note: Influence and approval are gameplay starting values for 1 January 2000 (PP minority government of José María Aznar, supported by CiU, PNV and Canarian Coalition, during an economic boom), not measured data. Influence reflects institutional weight: strong employers' organisations and banks, two large union confederations (CCOO and UGT) with collective-bargaining weight, a Catholic Church with a privileged but non-official status, a conscript army being professionalised and under civilian control, and strong regional and national minority identities (Catalan, Basque, Galician).
